summary: Session 2 of 3: Option B implementation — wrote AccessHarvester.Access/FormMetadataExtractor.cs, ReportMetadataExtractor.cs, and the shared AccessHarvester.Access/AccessObjectReader.cs (internal helpers) following the established TableMetadataExtractor precedent. Extended SyntheticMetadataExtractorIntegrationTests to validate Forms and Reports categories against the 09-report-grouping-events.expected.json aspirational fixture via loose-match AssertForms/AssertReports/AssertGroupLevels comparators. PageSetup decoding from PrtMip/PrtDevMode and per-level GroupingMode/Interval/SortOrder/KeepTogether decoding deferred per spec/audit-findings (no real-fixture evidence yet; the typed schema documents both as best-effort/nullable). Step 6 code review (Sonnet → gemini-pro VERIFIED) surfaced 2 real bugs fixed in-session: Reports DefaultView wrong label table (forms enumeration applied to reports — added separate ReportMetadataExtractor.DefaultViewLabels with 0=Report View, 1=Print Preview, 2=Layout View), and GroupLevel<N> keys not removed from Properties bag after exact-value lift (refactored BuildGroupLevels to thread a consumed-keys HashSet that augments PromotedRootKeys before BuildPromotedPropertiesBag runs). Step 8 Round 1 ISSUES_FOUND 1 Major (AssertForms/AssertReports unconditionally compared scalar fields via ReadOptionalString, treating missing fixture keys as expected-null) — fixed in-session via new AssertIfFixturePresent helper mirroring AssertGroupLevels's conditional pattern; Round 2 VERIFIED (gpt-5-4).

reason.specifics: Session 3 authors hermetic unit tests for FormMetadataExtractor and ReportMetadataExtractor (GroupLevels edge cases, DefaultView decoding for both enumerations, RecordSource/Filter/OrderBy promotion correctness, AccessControl recursion, LabelInfo case mapping, PageSetup deferral pin) PLUS docs/ir-schema-forms-reports.md (typed schema as the public contract for downstream AI, worked example with raw ir/ JSON and typed records side by side). Premium-tier orchestrator is the right call per the routed recommendation (gemini-pro via route(analysis), 2026-05-14) — synthesis precision on both test generation and prose generation justifies Opus at effort=high.
